title: Fair Scheduler Mesh
tagline: Compare four workload-to-core assignment strategies by predicted latency growth.

curves.label: Round-Robin Core Ring
curves.code: for (t=0; t<n; t++) core = t % k; enqueue(core,t);
curves.name: Round-Robin Core Ring

curves.label: Least-Loaded with Sampling
curves.code: for (t=0; t<n; t++){ s=sampleCores(r); core=argmin(load[core] among s); enqueue(core,t); }
curves.name: Least-Loaded with Sampling

curves.label: Hierarchical Work-Stealing
curves.code: for each worker i: push(task,i); if idle: steal from victim (local->remote); update_deques();
curves.name: Hierarchical Work-Stealing

curves.label: Lottery Ticket Transfer
curves.code: maintain tickets per class; for task t: pick winner via weighted RNG; enqueue(winner,t);
curves.name: Lottery Ticket Transfer

curves.label: Global Priority Heap (Single Queue)
curves.code: heap=priorityQueue(); for (t=0; t<n; t++) heap.push(task(t)); while(heap.size) run(heap.popMin());
curves.name: Global Priority Heap (Single Queue)
